en: A color illustration of an early 20th‑century ocean liner, the S.S. "Mooltan", cutting through rough seas. The ship has two tall black funnels emitting smoke, multiple lifeboats along the deck, and a single prominent mast. In the upper left corner, printed text advertises the P. & O. India‑China‑Australia Mail and Passenger Services, giving the ship's tonnage and horsepower.
